newsitem.title: USA: Cable Design adopts preferred rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Cable Design adopts preferred rights plan.

text.p: Cable Design Technologies Inc said Wednesday its board adopted a preferred share purchase rights plan at its December 10 meeting.
The company said it declared a dividend distribution of one preferred share purchase right for each outstanding common share to stockholders of record December 26.

Cable Design also said it had been cleared by the New York Stock Exchange to apply for listing. It said it planned to file an application shortly and expected to be listed on the exchange within the next 60 days.
The company said it was pleased with its performance over the past year and looked forward to a successful 1997.
